text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a razor-sharp run that seems to tear 
through the air, Sirius Symboli charges 
through the Kikuka-sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next goal she set for herself was the 
Arima Kinen. It would be a direct showdown 
against Symboli Rudolf— something she had 
avoided for so long.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She claims she feels no loneliness, but 
simply avoided it because it held no 
value—and she takes on the challenge to 
prove her words.
